state.evaluationScope: Plan45 Phase1 implementation checkpoint: separate Vitest Browser Mode setup and required pre-push validation gate.
state.background: Judge only the stated Phase1 objective: add a dedicated real-browser Vitest Browser Mode path and ensure pre-push invokes it in changed/full profiles with reliable failure-stop semantics. User clarified that pre-push is sufficient; a separate CI requirement should not be invented. The current phase does NOT claim full migration or that the 33 current MAP-ineligible scenarios are truly ineligible. Phase5 must investigate each of those 33 stable IDs in detail and may revise those eligibility decisions.
implementationEvidence: vitest.browser.config.ts is a separate Vitest 4 Browser Mode config using @vitest/browser-playwright 4.1.11, Chromium headless, 1280x800 viewport, tests/browser-mode/**/*.browser.test.tsx, excludes tests/e2e, keeps failure screenshots/traces.
package.json exposes test:browser and test:full; default pnpm test continues using the happy-dom config and excludes Browser Mode through separate config selection.
Real ThemeToggle client component browser tests cover browser click and persisted theme state plus style/color assertions; tests are self-contained browser contracts.

Pre-push changed profile runs related tests and then test:browser; empty, failed, unsafe or indeterminate related selection falls back to full profile. Full profile runs lint:fast, type-check, test:all, test:browser, build, build parity, security, E2E. Both profiles stop on gate failure.

Hook smoke coverage exercises full and changed profile gate ordering/failure stops, including Browser Mode failure rejection; fixture remote refs are checked unchanged on rejected push and later gates are skipped.

Reported verification: pnpm test:browser 2/2 pass; CI=1 pnpm test:browser 2/2 pass when the local Playwright browser path is explicitly configured because sandbox cache redirection otherwise affects browser cache lookup; pnpm test 84 files, 772 passed, 4 skipped; pnpm lint and pnpm type-check pass with XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp because default pnpm dlx cache path is sandbox read-only; pnpm run test:hook-smoke passes full and changed failure cases.

No actual external push was performed. Chromium installation is a one-time manual precondition. No Next production route, SSR, Flight, hydration or full app shell claim is made by this Phase1 checkpoint.
acceptanceCriteria: Dedicated real browser Vitest execution exists and can be invoked independently of the happy-dom suite.
The standard test command retains its happy-dom suite, while Browser Mode runs via its separate explicit config.
Pre-push is the agreed required local gate; it invokes Browser Mode for changed and full profiles, and conservatively fails closed/falls back when changed-test selection is unsafe or indeterminate.
Hook smoke evidence covers failure-stop behavior so a failed required gate blocks the push and later gates do not run.

Acceptance is limited to Phase1 setup/pre-push wiring; it does not claim external push verification, Next production integration, or final eligibility for the 33 MAP-ineligible scenarios. Phase5 must individually investigate all 33.
state.outputRequirement: Select one choice for each keyed question. Treat reported test/check outputs as supplied evidence. Select valid_as_defined only if it is supported by this evidence and the stated scope. For any defect/evidence gap, select the most specific diagnosis categories and action/uncertainty categories.

phase1_verdict.instructions: Does the supplied implementation meet the Phase1 acceptance criteria within its stated scope? Select exactly one verdict.

criteria.valid_as_defined: Phase1 is implemented correctly and is ready as the dedicated Vitest Browser Mode setup plus required pre-push gate, within the explicitly stated scope and evidence limits.
criteria.implementation_change_needed: A specific implementation or pre-push defect blocks Phase1 acceptance; identify the exact defect from the supplied evidence.
criteria.plan_or_spec_change_needed: The implementation is sound but the Plan45 phase boundary or OpenSpec requirement is inconsistent with the agreed Phase1 scope; identify exact wording to revise.
criteria.evidence_gap_requires_hold: No concrete code or plan defect is established, but existing evidence is insufficient to mark Phase1 complete; identify the exact missing evidence.

primary_finding.instructions: Which best describes the primary finding supported by the supplied implementation and evidence?

criteria.browser_runner_config: Browser Mode config, provider, script, or browser test integration defect.
criteria.standard_test_regression: Happy-dom/default test routing or standard test suite regression.
criteria.prepush_routing: Pre-push changed/full profile routing, fallback, ordering, or gate failure-stop defect.
criteria.hook_smoke_coverage: Hook smoke scenarios fail to demonstrate required failure-stop behavior.
criteria.plan_spec_mismatch: Phase1 implementation and plan/spec wording materially disagree.
criteria.evidence_scope_gap: Evidence is insufficient to verify a Phase1 contract.
criteria.other_concrete_issue: A different specific issue is evidenced in the provided context.

next_action.instructions: What should happen immediately after this checkpoint? Select one action, keeping change targets separated.

criteria.accept_phase1_and_continue: Accept Phase1 setup/pre-push gate and proceed to the next planned phase; Phase5 remains responsible for detailed per-ID investigation of all 33 MAP-ineligible scenarios.
criteria.fix_implementation: Change implementation only to fix a concrete defect; leave plan/spec text unchanged.
criteria.revise_plan_spec: Revise plan/spec text only to align requirements to the agreed Phase1 scope; leave implementation unchanged.
criteria.collect_evidence_only: Collect the specific missing evidence only; do not change implementation or plan/spec.
criteria.hold_for_scope_decision: Hold because the supplied evidence exposes an ambiguity about the agreed Phase1 boundary.

remaining_uncertainty.instructions: Which remaining uncertainty applies to the Phase1 acceptance claim? Choose none only if the stated limitations are fully bounded and nonblocking.

criteria.none_for_phase1_scope: No remaining uncertainty for the defined Phase1 setup/pre-push objective; listed caveats are explicitly outside the acceptance claim.
criteria.chromium_install_precondition: Whether the documented one-time Chromium installation precondition is acceptable remains unclear.
criteria.external_push_unverified: An actual external push was not performed, so production remote interaction is not evidenced.
criteria.next_production_boundary: Next production routes, SSR, Flight, hydration or full app shell behavior was not verified and is outside Phase1.
criteria.test_result_indeterminate: Some required local test/lint/type-check/hook-smoke result is missing or indeterminate.
criteria.other_specific_uncertainty: Another exact uncertainty remains; use only if supported by the supplied context.
